items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: just out of Dixieland was Basie and Ellington

ctx.x: How did other people react to Bird's music?

Oh yeah, it was knocke'd, it was nearly a strike. I mean, the guys, they couldn't play it see, cause they were still into Dixieland really, just out of Dixieland was Basie and Ellington, the way we played, and Eddie they went with Ben Webster. A few other groups even Stuff Smith & Eddie -- South. Even violin players was in it. Then

cats could play, not no gettin' around it. So it was. But they weren't into this new thing. 75% would speak against it. Say oh, man I don't know what they're playin' -- Chinese music. They'd call it everything. That's because they couldn't play it. It was out of their reach. Don Byas could reach it. He didn't have the tone, but he could play the notes -- he was in it. One of the few that I could remember. Somehow they finally hooked up, Parker and Diz, ... Al Haig used to play with me and I let him go overnight.…
